feed.title: Craft Scoreboard: new lab results
feed.subtitle: Free Craft apps tested version by version on a real lab PC.

entry.title: PdfCraft 0.14.0: no score, while you work: 0
entry.summary: Retest: redacting a scanned page still deletes the whole page (same 1,297-byte file as 0.9.0; GitHub issue #2246 still open). Text redaction still works. Measured 26 Oct 2026 on our Windows 11 lab PC.

entry.title: WordCraft 0.11.0: no score, while you work: 0
entry.summary: Retest: still 3 of 12 planted errors, spelling only, although "Mark grammar errors as you type" is on by default. The 40-page report round trip still passes. Measured 26 Oct 2026 on our Windows 11 lab PC.

entry.title: GridCraft 0.12.1: 5.5/8, while you work: 0
entry.summary: 40 of 40 formulas and the pivot totals right. Opened only 49,998 of 100,000 rows, and changed IDs (00123 to 123) and dates in a CSV without asking. Measured 26 Oct 2026 on our Windows 11 lab PC.

entry.title: DeckCraft 0.11.1: 3/3, while you work: 0
entry.summary: All 3 jobs passed: the 10-slide deck opened right (table, chart, notes), presented with transitions and exported a matching 10-page PDF. The README still calls it early development. Measured 26 Oct 2026 on our Windows 11 lab PC.

entry.title: Microsoft Excel for the web build seen 26 Oct 2026: 6.5/8, while you work: 118 hosts
entry.summary: Opened all 100,000 rows. Changed the same CSV without asking (and broke the accented names). Every file opened was uploaded to OneDrive. Measured 26 Oct 2026 on our Windows 11 lab PC, browser.

entry.title: Microsoft PowerPoint for the web build seen 26 Oct 2026: 2.5/3, while you work: not measured
entry.summary: The deck opened right and exported a matching PDF. Slides advanced, but I didn't see the 2 transitions play in 3 recorded runs. Measured 26 Oct 2026 on our Windows 11 lab PC, browser.
